reason.description: The first gate attempted to isolate unaided cognition by prohibiting normal cognitive tools such as code, search and AI assistance. That design does not match the intended target: Hawkar operating in the native JANUS/Habitat environment as a tool-using systems researcher.

design_correction.principle: Do not remove the subject's ordinary cognitive instruments merely to claim purity. Instead separate strategy ownership from mechanical execution by logging decision checkpoints, hypothesis ordering, tool calls, revisions and falsification choices.
design_correction.ai_separation_method: Instead of banning AI, record which conceptual moves originate from the subject before or between tool-assisted executions, and distinguish STRATEGY_OWNER from EXECUTION_ASSISTANCE in each checkpoint.

baseline_effect.note: No intelligence estimate is reduced because of this failed protocol design.
